propositions: When a final push is rejected on an ephemeral runner after the rebar-id Jira label is stamped but before local CREATE event and binding are durably published, the local state is lost while the label persists, creating a permanently stuck unbound_jira drift.
The binding_walk L10 guard and binding recovery paths skip recovery when the rebar-id label is present, leaving marked-but-unstored keys unhealed.

The fix implements idempotent recovery in binding_walk.py's phase-1b unbound arm: a marked key is replayed through the existing inbound-create leaf only when its label equals the deterministic inbound id, no binding-store entry exists, and no local ticket exists.
Recovery extension pairs best-effort label-stamping ordering with deterministic idempotent replay keyed on _jira_key_to_local_id, matching OSS transactional-outbox and Debezium consumer patterns.
The L10 guard remains unconditional (standing down) for foreign markers, multi-marker keys, keys with existing store entries, and retired keys, preserving existing L10/L11 double-bind protections.
